implemented: D-014 is launched by the packaged electron.exe with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 and NODE_OPTIONS cleared; standalone Node never loads the ABI-110 binding.
A8-03/A8-04/A8-05 reports use evidence schema v2 and record candidate_id plus candidate_manifest_sha256.
Every report verifies the complete release-manifest file set; missing, changed, extra or symlink payloads fail closed.
Formal reports require Win32 x64, Electron 22.3.27, Node 16.17.1, ABI 110, operator identity and an explicit Win10/Win7 layer.
Reports and screenshots are written only to a sibling evidence root; verify-a8-evidence-set.mjs binds all reports to one manifest.
Dirty source packages record external_acceptance_eligible=false and are rejected before Electron startup. Generated out/ is ignored by the source check.
remaining: Review and commit the complete A8 source, then rebuild without --allow-uncommitted and issue a new package/manifest hash.
Run the schema-v2 evidence set on the same clean candidate under Win10 and Win7.
Do not restore A8_DEVELOPER_COMPLETE_VALIDATION_READY or A8_RC_PASS before those gates pass.
